Hi, my name's Abdel Hassoun.
I'm calling to reschedule my flight.
I can help you with that.
Do you have your booking confirmation number?
Yes, it's T3JG5.
One moment.
Okay, I can see your flight information, Mr. Hassoun.

Next Friday.
Any time would be okay.
We have one available flight that departs at noon.
That's great.
Okay, you'll get an email with your new flight information shortly.
